candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks for workflow setup or to create, update, publish, inspect, delete, or run a GTM workflow or its saved target/connection in an existing GTM workspace, including Clay-, n8n-, Vercel-, local-, scheduled-, triggered-, enrichment-, CRM-cleaning-, inbound-, or outbound-workflow requests. Not for creating, importing, repairing, or deleting the workspace itself; ICP or persona authoring; account or lead research; or a one-off provider action that should not become a saved workflow.
candidates.rationale: Incumbent routing rule measured as the non-regression baseline.

candidates.description: Triggers when the requested result changes or operates a saved GTM workflow artifact in an existing GTM workspace: set up targets or connections; create or build; update, publish, activate, or make live; inspect workflow state or node health; delete; or run. Covers Clay, n8n, Vercel Workflows, local TypeScript, scheduled, triggered, enrichment, CRM-cleaning, inbound, and outbound automations. Not for workspace lifecycle or structural repair, ICP/persona work, account or lead research, generic CI workflows, or one-off provider actions with no saved workflow outcome.
candidates.rationale: Makes the durable workflow outcome the routing discriminator and expands publish phrasing.

candidates.description: Triggers when a user wants to manage the lifecycle of a node-owned GTM workflow, target, or connection in an existing GTM workspace—including setup, creation, updates, publishing, inspection, deletion, and runs for Clay-, n8n-, Vercel-, local-, scheduled-, triggered-, enrichment-, inbound-, outbound-, or CRM-cleaning workflows. Not for merely invoking a provider action, creating or repairing the workspace repo, defining ICPs or personas, researching or scoring accounts/leads, or repairing CI automation.
candidates.rationale: Leads with lifecycle ownership and explicitly separates invoke-only and CI near-misses.

candidates.description: Triggers when a GTM workspace request says set up workflow targets, create or build an automation, update or publish it, inspect its state or workflow health, delete it, or run it with saved target semantics. Use for reusable Clay, n8n, Vercel Workflows, local TypeScript, enrichment, CRM-cleaning, inbound, outbound, scheduled, and triggered workflows. Not for GTM workspace creation/import/repair, ICP or persona lifecycle work, account or lead research/scoring, GitHub Actions, or an unsaved one-off call through a provider plugin.
candidates.rationale: Uses literal user language and concrete near-miss exclusions in a shorter description.
